classification.difficultyReason: Select convenient nearby percentages or rounded quantities, reverse the percentage relationship to estimate the whole, and compare with the listed options; the estimation strategy is explicitly supplied.

inlines.text: Without using a calculator, draw a line to match each percentage on the left to the estimate of the whole on the right. Use nearby benchmark percentages and, where helpful, round the given quantities to make mental calculations easier. Choose the closest estimate listed.
